lines.t: I come to you with nothing to hide, no more mask, no more pride
All my failures, all my fears, I lay them down, I draw near
You already know my heart
You see every broken part
Still you want the real me
Calling me to honesty
Because you want it all
Truth and confession
Everyone falls in your presence
You know everything, nothing's new
Still your love keeps breaking through
When I'm honest with you, your mercy flows down
When I'm honest with you, unconditional love surrounds
It's not enough to fake a smile
You see through my every trial
You desire what's truly there
The moment I breathe a prayer
You're desperate to pour out grace When I finally show my face
At my lowest you draw close Loving deeper than I know
Because you want it all, truth and confession Every wall falls in your presence
You know everything, nothing's new Still your love keeps breaking through
When I'm honest with you, your mercy flows down
When I'm honest with you, unconditional love surrounds

Because you want it all, truth and confession
Every wall falls in your presence

Still your love keeps breaking through

When I'm honest with you
